ValidationRule.description: Required Fields upon creation: Mailing and Billing Address; City; Zip Code
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( IsPersonAccount, OR( ISBLANK(PersonMailingStreet), ISBLANK(PersonMailingCity), ISBLANK(PersonMailingPostalCode), ISBLANK(BillingAddress), ISBLANK(BillingCity), ISBLANK(BillingPostalCode) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Mailing and Billing Address Info are required.
